causes.label: Not enough water
why: You said the water turn on 2026-11-09 was not done.
The same squares also look drier in the moisture index (NDMI).
Yellow leaves can also come from thirst.

causes.label: Hungry for fertilizer (nitrogen)
why: A fertilizer dose on your plan is late or not done.

alerts.action: Walk to the north-east corner and look at the leaves: colour, spots, insects. Then tell us what you saw.
